_doc: The kind table of workflows-core:document-lineage. One row per document kind. match: basename regexes. covered: true where producers record upstreams and the walk reads this kind's own record. reviser: the command that revises this kind when it is the stale downstream. version: 'header' where the kind's header carries '- **Version**: N', else null. items: start-line regexes, one capture group = the item id, with a nesting level (ids that restart under a parent are keyed by their full path). notes: heading regexes opening a section excluded from comparison until the next heading of the same or a higher level. ignore_lines: line regexes excluded from comparison. Text outside every item is compared per '## ' section. _source: where each row was measured.

specification._source: product-workflows/references/specification-format.md: Stage 3 (### [U01]), Stage 4 (#### [AC01], restarts per story), Stage 5 (**[TC01]:, restarts per AC), Live items, Notes other commands write, Header

epic._source: product-workflows/agents/epic-writer.md: the epic.md template under Write mechanics carries no item ids of its own

design._source: dev-workflows/references/design-format.md: Header (Version), Traceability & identifiers (cites spec ids, defines none)

prd._source: workflows-core/references/prd-format.md:144-147,153,162,181 (### [US#N]: headings; [AC#N] bullets under a label line; ids global, never renumbered)
